PDF.js 5.4.624 (pdfjs-dist, Mozilla) — Apache License 2.0, see LICENSE.txt.
Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/pdfjs-dist (build/pdf.min.mjs, build/pdf.worker.min.mjs, standard_fonts/).
Files renamed .mjs -> .js so every host serves them as JavaScript. Not modified otherwise.
Standard fonts: Foxit (BSD, LICENSE_FOXIT) and Liberation (SIL OFL, LICENSE_LIBERATION).
Used by the M03 library reader (ui/js/library.js) to show PDF pages in the browser; nothing is loaded from outside.
